question: Wata malamar makarantar yara tana aiki a kan wannan manufar koyo mai zuwa daga ginshikin Harshe na Baka: “Fahimtar, ta hanyar sauraro mai da hankali, abubuwan da ke bayyane daga rubuce-rubucen adabi da waɗanda ba na adabi ba, gane muhimman ra’ayoyi, nuna abubuwan da aka fi so, yin bayani mai sauƙi, da yin tambayoyi game da abin da ke ciki.” Don gudanar da kimanta tsari, an saita wannan ma’aunin nasara mai zuwa: Yana fahimtar abubuwan da ke bayyane daga rubuce-rubucen adabi. Wane ne daga cikin waɗannan ayyuka ya dace don samun shaida na matakin cimma wannan ma’aunin nasara da aka nuna?
answer_a: Mai koyarwar ya nuna wa yara murfin tatsuniyar nan "Zomo da Kunkuru" sa'annan ya tambaye su me suke tsammanin labarin zai kunsa
answer_b: Malamin ya gayyaci yaran su kwaikwayi tatsuniyar "Zaki da Bera," sannan ya tambaye su game da darasin da labarin da halayen cikinsa suka koya
answer_c: Mai koyarwa ya faɗi labarin "Dodo Mai Launi" sannan ya tambayi yaran waɗanne launuka ne motsin ran da Dodo Mai Launi ya gane suke da su
answer_d: Malamin ya gayyaci yaran su yi wasan kwaikwayo na labarin "No Laughing, Pepe", sannan ya tambaye su wane ɓangare suka fi so a labarin, kuma ya ƙarfafa su su ƙirƙiri wani ƙarshen daban ga labarin.

question: Wane ilimin farko ne ya kamata ɗalibin ya mallaka domin gane baitocin hendekasyllabic?

Malami yana aiki a matakin fahimtar karatu na dogaro da tunani (inferential level) bisa ga karanta gajeren labarin nan mai zuwa: Hutun Shekara mai zuwa iyalina suna shirin zuwa wata. Mahaifiyata ta gaya min in gayyaci abokina idan ina so, tabbas, don kar in ji gundura dole ta yi tunani. Gaskiyar ita ce ban ji daɗin hakan sosai ba, ban sani ba, ban taɓa son fita daga duniyar ba sosai, na gwammace in ci taliya (noodles) da miya da cuku. Ko ta yaya, abokina tace za ta so ta tafi, amma ta gaya min tana buƙatar sabon bikini, suna cewa mata a kan wata suna da kyau sosai, amma ban yarda ba. Za mu zauna a Otel Armstrong kuma za mu yi tafiya a kan Pullmanmoon (da fatan yana da bandaki). Zan kawo kankana. Catalina Yáñez Wace tambaya malamin zai iya yi wa ɗalibai don haɓaka karatu a matakin dogaro da tunani?
answer_a: Mene jarumin yake ji game da tafiyar zuwa wata?
answer_b: Yaya tafiyar hutu zuwa wata ya kamata ta kasance?
answer_c: Don so Uwar jarumar ta gaya mata ta gayyaci abokiya?
answer_d: Wane hali jigon ya nuna game da tafiyar a ƙarshen labarin?
